name: Algebraic Subgraph Indicator
description: Replaces the "local stability" summation with a mathematically equivalent boolean polynomial $I(x) = \sum x_i - \sum x_u x_v = 1$. This obscures the topological meaning (vertices minus edges = 1, i.e., exactly one connected component in a forest) while remaining perfectly rigorous. It prevents models from pattern-matching the text to a subtree problem without first deducing the algebraic equivalence.
